svg.title: Scalable e-commerce platform: reference architecture
svg.text: A scalable e-commerce platform: reference architecture
Cloud-neutral. Browse traffic is served from caches at the top; only buying reaches the strongly consistent stores at the bottom.
1 Edge: absorb the crowd before it reaches you
turned on for drops and sales
2 Entry: one front door per client type
3 Domain services: each owns its data, none shares a database
Rule: services call each other only for data they need in the request. Everything else travels as events.
4 Events: what happened, published once, consumed by many
topics: order.placed, payment.captured, stock.changed, price.changed, order.shipped
5 Data: the right store per job
Every buy-path store runs across three zones with synchronous replicas. Browse stores can lag seconds behind; nobody notices.
Names are generic on purpose. Parts 5 to 9 of this series map each box to AWS, Azure and Google Cloud services.
